During the mango harvest near Ratnagiri, Ojas, two, toddled toward the old well at the edge of the orchard.

"Ojas, come back," Kunal called firmly.

Ojas stopped, turned, and ran back to his father's side.

Later, when the family sat down to eat under the tree, Ojas watched his father touch Ajoba's feet. He copied him, bending clumsily, and Ajoba laughed and hugged him.

qa.q: Where was Ojas toddling toward?
qa.a: He toddled toward the old well at the edge of the orchard.

qa.q: How did Ajoba feel when Ojas touched his feet?
qa.a: Ajoba was delighted and warm, laughing and hugging him.

qa.q: How can Kunal keep Ojas safe near the well?
qa.a: Keep calling him firmly, stay close, and keep him away from the well.

qa.q: What might Ojas feel when he copies his father?
qa.a: Ojas may feel proud and part of the family, doing what the grown-ups do.

grounding: During the mango harvest, a toddler accepts his father's firm guidance and shows affection for his grandfather.

Winter in Oslo made the pavements slippery. Tuan held out his hand at the crossing. "Freya, hold Papa's hand."

Freya, two, wanted to run. She stamped her boot, then took his hand.

At home, her grandmother called on video from Hanoi. Freya pressed the screen and said, "Bà! Bà!" and blew kisses until the call ended.

qa.q: Where did Freya's grandmother call from?
qa.a: Her grandmother called on video from Hanoi.

qa.q: How did Freya feel when she stamped her boot?
qa.a: Freya felt frustrated because she wanted to run, but still took her father's hand.

qa.q: How can Tuan help Freya accept his guidance at crossings?
qa.a: Keep the rule the same every time and let her run freely on safe ground afterwards.

qa.q: How might Freya's grandmother feel receiving her kisses?
qa.a: Her grandmother was likely touched and joyful, even from far away.

grounding: On icy winter pavements, a toddler accepts her father's guidance and shows affection for her grandmother.
